name: Cisco Secure Firewall REST API MCP Server
shortDescription: MCP server exposing Cisco Secure Firewall (FMC) REST tooling to AI agents, with a preview-confirm-apply gate on every configuration change.
description: Gives an AI agent the FMC REST API behind a safety harness. Read-only tools cover inventory, object search with IP-containment matching, object-usage tracing, access-rule listing, and deployment status. Configuration changes are split into a preview tool that returns a plan plus an HMAC confirmation token bound to that plan, and an apply tool that refuses any token which does not authorise exactly the plan it was given. Writes are disabled entirely unless the operator sets FMC_ALLOW_WRITES=true.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.description: Domains, devices, policies, and object counts.

tools.name: search_objects
tools.description: Find objects by name, value, or IP containment.

tools.name: find_object_usage
tools.description: Which access rules reference an object.

tools.name: preview_object_changes
tools.description: Diff proposed objects and issue a confirmation token.

tools.name: apply_object_changes
tools.description: Apply a previewed plan. Gated by FMC_ALLOW_WRITES and a plan-bound token.

safety.confirmationBinding: HMAC over canonical plan JSON, per-process key, 300s TTL

support: Community, best effort. Not supported by Cisco TAC.
